senses.definition_en: a tire repair shop

examples.english: They can fix up your tire in the repair shop nearby.
examples.text: Te pueden parchar la llanta en la vulka de aquí cerca.
examples.translation: They can fix up your tire in the repair shop nearby.

examples.english: Phrases like these can come from the writings of Voltaire or from the mouth of the guy changing your Firestone tire in a repair shop, it all depends on the mysterious charm contained in the choice of words.
examples.ref: 2014, Jaime Muñoz Vargas, “Nadie te espera”, in Milenio:
examples.text: Esas frases pueden salir de la pluma de Voltaire o de la boca del compita que nos cambia la Firestone en una vulka, todo depende del misterioso encanto que contenga la pizca de palabras.
examples.translation: Phrases like these can come from the writings of Voltaire or from the mouth of the guy changing your Firestone tire in a repair shop, it all depends on the mysterious charm contained in the choice of words.

examples.english: […] workers from the tire repair shop assisted the injured man, who was bleeding profusely due to his wounds.
examples.ref: 2016, Manolo Acosta, “Llanta ‘revienta’ cara a ingeniero”, in Zócalo:
examples.text: […] los empleados de la vulka ayudaron al lesionado, quien sangraba de manera abundante debido a las lesiones.
examples.translation: […] workers from the tire repair shop assisted the injured man, who was bleeding profusely due to his wounds.

examples.english: It was his dad's, the madman who 35 years before had begun to live in a jalopy van with his wife and nine children on the roadside of the toll-free Saltillo–Torreón highway, on kilometer 64, where he opened a tire repair shop.
examples.ref: 2017, Jesús Peña, “La historia de un kilómetro de carretera que se convierte en un pueblo”, in Vanguardia:
examples.text: De su papá, el loco que hace 35 años se puso a vivir en una chatarra de combi con su mujer y sus nueve hijos a la orilla de la carretera libre Saltillo – Torreón, en el kilómetro 64 y abrió una vulka.
examples.translation: It was his dad's, the madman who 35 years before had begun to live in a jalopy van with his wife and nine children on the roadside of the toll-free Saltillo–Torreón highway, on kilometer 64, where he opened a tire repair shop.

glosses: a tire repair shop
